lines.en: Hooves crunch on the snow.
This slope is too steep. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊走，脚下是云。
lines.en: I walk the ridge with clouds below.

lines.zh: 冰面上我不滑，蹄子抓得牢。
lines.en: I do not slip on ice; my hooves grip.
Powder snow to my knees, and I keep going.

lines.zh: 从这块石头，跳到那块石头。
lines.en: From this rock, leap to that one.
The herd is ahead; I follow.
Wind off the peak pushes me.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边啃两口草。
lines.en: I walk and nibble grass as I go.
Downhill, I do not slow either.
Stones underfoot grind my hooves sharp.

lines.zh: 我走前面，别的羊跟后头。
lines.en: I walk first; the others trail behind.
I have walked this path a hundred times.

lines.zh: 雪化的时候，我踩出一串坑。
lines.en: As snow melts, I leave a trail of holes.

lines.zh: 我站稳了才跳，落地很实。
lines.en: I jump only when set, and land hard.

lines.zh: 雪坡上的石头，我一块块踩过。
lines.en: I step stone by stone up the snow slope.
I stand; wind ruffles my beard.

lines.zh: 山那么高，我懒得抬头看。
lines.en: The mountain is high; I cannot be bothered.
My horns itch; I rub them on stone.

lines.zh: 他们都叫我最吵的那只。
lines.en: They call me the loudest of the herd.
Chewing grass, wondering who to ram.
I claimed this snow slope first.

lines.zh: 有只羊在看我，我没理它。
lines.en: A goat stares; I ignore it.
I lift my head to look taller.
The mountain wind smells of ice.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，雪掉下来。
lines.en: I snort, and snow falls loose.
Standing long is good for the hooves.
Someone climbs the hill. So slow.
I count the herd; one is missing.
Sun on my horns, warm.
The wind pushed the clouds along. I didn't move.
I'm watching to see who blinks first.
You smell of wheat.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着什么？给我看看。
lines.en: What is in your hand? Show me.

lines.zh: 别站在坡下，我冲起来收不住。
lines.en: Not below the slope; I cannot stop once I charge.
You are taller, and I am not scared.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，头是歪的。
lines.en: When I look at you, my head tilts.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了我的草。
lines.en: Your boots are crushing my grass.

lines.zh: 我们山羊，先看角再看人。
lines.en: We goats size up the horns first.
Do not laugh; I understand it.

lines.zh: 你站那儿别动，我要过去了。
lines.en: Stand still; I am coming over.

lines.zh: 你的帽子挺好看，能顶下来吗？
lines.en: Nice hat. Can I knock it off?

lines.zh: 我在想要不要用角招呼你。
lines.en: I am deciding whether to greet you with horns.
You stare; so do I.
You struck my horn. Useless.
That does not count. Again.

lines.zh: 我腿软了一下，马上站直。
lines.en: My legs buckled; I straightened at once.
A tuft of my coat is gone. Ugly.

lines.zh: 疼得我乱跳，跳上了石头。
lines.en: It stung so I leapt onto a rock.
I do not run. Goats do not run.

lines.zh: 你的箭射偏了，扎在雪里。
lines.en: Your arrow missed and stuck in the snow.
I shake my horns to throw the pain off.
I will remember you for that.
Stop; my horn is crooked now.
Wheat? Hand it over. Now.

lines.zh: 我闻到麦子了，别藏身后。
lines.en: I smell wheat; do not hide it behind you.
Wave it and I will follow you.
Just one bite; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 那捆草在背包里吧？我闻到了。
lines.en: That bundle of grass in your bag? I smell it.

lines.zh: 为了一口麦子，我能爬坡。
lines.en: For a mouthful of wheat, I will climb.

lines.zh: 你把小麦撒了，那是我的。
lines.en: You dropped the wheat. Mine.
Do not back away; I do not bite.

lines.zh: 麦子在我嘴边，我就不动了。
lines.en: Wheat at my mouth, and I stop moving.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走一路，就为这个。
lines.en: I followed you all this way for this.
You walk fast; my hooves are faster.
One more handful and you may touch my horns.

lines.zh: 麦粒掉在雪上，我照样吃。
lines.en: Wheat on the snow, I eat it anyway.
Do not fob me off with carrots.
You crouch, so I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 那把麦子放在石头上，我去拿。
lines.en: Leave the wheat on the rock. I'll take it.
Ram me? I ram back first.
My head knocked you back two steps.
My horns are not decoration.

lines.zh: 你站我下坡，吃亏的是你。
lines.en: Stand downhill of me and you lose.
What is the shoving? Make room.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩到你脚背了，抱歉。
lines.en: My hoof found your foot. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我们撞一下，算打过招呼。
lines.en: A headbutt counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了三成力。
lines.en: That was only three-tenths of my strength.
You are heavier, not steadier.
One more bump and I get truly angry.

lines.zh: 两只羊对着顶角，就算说好。
lines.en: Two goats butt horns: that is the agreement.

lines.zh: 她站在坡上，我站在坡下。
lines.en: She stands above; I stand below.
I give her the best patch of grass.
The kid can leap the moment it is born.

lines.zh: 只有百分之五的运气，才这么小。
lines.en: Only a five percent chance to be this small.

lines.zh: 我守着她，不让别的羊靠近。
lines.en: I guard her from the other goats.
Horn on horn makes a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 山里的风，也知道我们成对了。
lines.en: Even the mountain wind knows we paired.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，整座山都听见。
lines.en: She bleats once; the whole mountain hears.

lines.zh: 等小羊长大，让它走前面。
lines.en: When the kid grows, it walks in front.

lines.zh: 地上有麦粒，我捡起来吃。
lines.en: Wheat on the ground; I pick it up and eat.
I do not collect things; I chew them.

lines.zh: 那块面包掉在雪里，可惜。
lines.en: That bread fell in the snow. A shame.
My mouth knows only grass and wheat.

lines.zh: 你掉的镐子，我顶了一下。
lines.en: Your dropped pick: I butted it.
Too hard; my teeth cannot manage it.

lines.zh: 我把草叼在嘴里，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I hold grass in my mouth and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 雪下面有嫩芽，我挖出来。
lines.en: Green shoots under snow; I dig them out.
Not mine; I only sniff it.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，别跟我说话。
lines.en: My mouth is full; do not talk to me.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我低下头。
lines.en: You turn, and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 坡上那个影子，我盯上了。
lines.en: That shape on the slope: I have chosen it.

lines.zh: 你已经退到崖边了，还退？
lines.en: You are at the cliff edge. Still backing up?
My horns are level with your waist.
One charge is enough.
You stepped into my ground.

lines.zh: 那只羊在看，我要证明给它看。
lines.en: That goat is watching; I will show it.
My hind hooves paw the dirt twice.

lines.zh: 你手里没麦子，那就没得谈。
lines.en: No wheat in your hand? Then no deal.
Locked on you. Here I come.
I lower my body, horns forward.
I run; the hoofbeats quicken.
You dodge left; I lean left.
One more second standing there, do not blame me.
Snow kicked into a white haze.

lines.zh: 山壁会把我们撞在一起。
lines.en: The cliff will slam us together.
I bleat once to steel myself.
You had better jump onto a rock.
I practiced this charge all year.
Almost there. Hold your ground.
Hit. Your weapon flew off.
After the hit, I am a bit dizzy too.
The mountain echoes that one.
You were lifted half a block.

lines.zh: 角尖撞在盔甲上，嗡一声。
lines.en: Horn on armor: a ringing hum.
I step back half a pace, ready again.
I shake my head after, pretending it is fine.
You land in snow. Soft enough.

lines.zh: 我不是故意撞那么重的。
lines.en: I did not mean to hit that hard.
Stay down; I am not finished ramming.

lines.zh: 我落在雪坡上，四蹄一沉。
lines.en: I land on the snow slope; four hooves sink.
One more goat on the ridge.
Day broke, so I came out to graze.
This slope faces the sun. Just right.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里钻出来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I climb out of the snowdrift and shake.

lines.zh: 风比我先到，吹乱我的毛。
lines.en: The wind arrived first and ruffled my coat.
The herd is below; I am going down.

lines.zh: 脚下是尖峭山峰的碎石。
lines.en: Underfoot, the scree of a jagged peak.

lines.zh: 第一次看见世界，全是白的。
lines.en: First look at the world: all white.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，山谷回我三声。
lines.en: I bleat; the valley answers three times.
The smell of singed coat is choking.

lines.zh: 从崖上掉下来，蹄子发麻。
lines.en: Fell off the cliff; my hooves are numb.
Water to my neck; I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻跟头，落地还站着。
lines.en: The blast flipped me; I landed on my feet.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，我照样顶人。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder, and I still ram.

lines.zh: 药水味怪怪的，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: The potion smells odd; I sneeze.

lines.zh: 雪下面没有草，我饿得叫。
lines.en: No grass under the snow; I bleat with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在山顶，我角还发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the peak; my horns still tingle.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我掉下去了。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I am falling.
